verdict.rationale: mParticle documents a dedicated 'Transform data as it enters and leaves mParticle' capability (mparticle-docs-8) plus consent/forwarding filters (mparticle-docs-x3, mparticle-docs-25) that support in-pipeline filtering and enrichment before data reaches destinations. However, the evidence pack only gives the feature's title/tagline, not details on custom code/function support, transformation language, or hands-on examples of enrichment logic. Missing for 10: detailed documentation or examples of writing custom transformation code/functions, independent verification of transformation capabilities in production use.
